mapper.select: SELECT uo.org_id AS orgId, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM sys_user_org uo WHERE uo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND uo.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY uo.org_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_org SET path = #{newPrefix} || substring(path FROM length(#{oldPrefix}) + 1), update_time = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND path LIKE #{oldPrefix} || '%' AND del_flag = 0
